items.summaryZh: 前哈斯车队领队京特·施泰纳认为克里斯蒂安·霍纳与弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的可能性不大，并调侃相关传闻只是给自己新书做宣传。霍纳此前接受《泰晤士报》采访时称执教法拉利是"梦想"，并表示这是其职业生涯现阶段唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队。

items.originalTitle: Guenther Steiner jokes Christian Horner Ferrari talk is good book publicity
items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has dismissed the possibility of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working alongside each other at Ferrari, joking that the talk is good publicity for his book. Horner told The Times that working with Ferrari would be "the dream" and the only team where he would accept a non-ownership role at this stage of his career.
detailZh: 京特·施泰纳调侃克里斯蒂安·霍纳与法拉利的传闻是给书做宣传
京特·施泰纳否认了克里斯蒂安·霍纳与弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的可能性
前哈斯一级方程式车队领队京特·施泰纳认为克里斯蒂安·霍纳和弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利并肩工作的可能性不大。
关于霍纳未来去向的猜测在其接受《泰晤士报》采访后升温。霍纳表示他愿意考虑在马拉内罗车队担任领导职务。霍纳称与法拉利合作是"梦想"，并表示在他职业生涯的这个阶段，法拉利是他唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队。
在《红旗播客》节目中，施泰纳表示，霍纳只是在调整自己的策略，以求重返争冠行列，还打趣说他可能是想为自己的新书做些宣传。
“我认为克里斯蒂安想回到一级方程式，而且他说得很清楚，他不想再为任何人打工了。显然，他的A计划行不通，于是他就转向B计划，而如果他去了法拉利工作，就拿不到那里的股份，”施泰纳说。“我认为他想进去，并且他在那里看到了一个机会。”
他补充道：“另外，这对他来说也没有什么坏处。他要出一本书，这会有助于那本书的销售，或者也许没帮助，我们不知道，但至少算是有一点宣传。”
施泰纳还回应了关于霍纳与瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的问题，并否定了这种可能性。
"我认为弗雷德留在那里为克里斯蒂安工作的情况不会发生,"他说。"弗雷德本人是一个非常成功的人。但首先,我不知道弗雷德是否想离开,或者他是否不得不离开。
"说到底,弗雷德手上有一份合同,而在一级方程式里这些合同又值多少钱呢?我猜并不多,但那里没有容纳他们两个人的空间。这就是我的看法。那种情况不会发生。"
detailEn: Guenther Steiner jokes Christian Horner Ferrari talk is good book publicity
Guenther Steiner has dismissed the prospect of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working together at Ferrari
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has dismissed the possibility of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working alongside each other at Ferrari.

Speculation regarding Horner's future intensified after he told The Times he would consider a leadership role at the Maranello outfit. Horner described working with Ferrari as "the dream" and indicated it is the only team at which he would accept a non-ownership position at this stage of his career.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner suggested Horner is simply adapting his strategy to return to the championship and joked that he could be getting some publicity for his new book.

"I think Christian wants to come back to Formula 1, and he said clearly that he doesn't want to work for anybody anymore. Obviously, plan A for him doesn't work out, so he goes to plan B and he doesn't get a stake in Ferrari if he goes to work there," Steiner said. "I think he wants to come in and he sees an opportunity there."

He added: "The other thing, there's nothing bad for him in it as well. He's releasing a book so it will help the sale of that one, or maybe not, we don't know, but at least it's a little bit of publicity."
Steiner also addressed questions about Horner and Vasseur working together at Ferrari and dismissed the possibility.

"I don't think that's going to happen that Fred is staying there working for Christian," he said. "Fred in himself is a very successful guy. But first of all, I don't know that Fred wants to leave or that he has to leave.
"In the end, Fred has got a contract and how much are they worth in Formula 1? Not a lot, I guess, but there is not space for the two of them. That's my opinion on it. That is not going to happen."
keyPointsZh: 霍纳告诉《泰晤士报》，他愿意考虑在马拉内罗车队担任领导职务
霍纳形容与法拉利合作是"梦想"，并称这是他现阶段唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队
keyPointsEn: Horner told The Times he would consider a leadership role at the Maranello outfit.
Horner described working with Ferrari as "the dream" and the only team at which he would accept a non-ownership position at this stage of his career.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" amid F1 title pressure, says Naomi Schiff
items.summaryEn: Pundit Naomi Schiff believes championship leader Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" and must "get out of his head" to avoid crumbling under the pressure of the Formula 1 title fight.
detailZh: 娜奥米·希夫：安东内利在F1争冠压力下"吓到了自己"
娜奥米·希夫认为领跑积分榜的基米·安东内利必须克服F1争冠带来的心理压力。
评论员娜奥米·希夫表示，积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利已经"吓到了自己"，必须"摆脱心理包袱"，以避免在F1争冠的压力下崩溃。
这位梅赛德斯车手带着81分的巨大领先优势来到阿塞拜疆大奖赛。但队友乔治·拉塞尔成功将杆位转化为分站冠军，而安东内利从第16位发车后仅获第五名，优势因此缩小到66分。
在“Up To Speed”播客节目中，前女子系列赛（W Series）车手、天空体育F1评论员希夫警告说，这位意大利车手在巴库的身体语言表明，他开始感受到首次争夺总冠军所带来的压力。
“我感觉这个周末我在赛道上观察基米时，不仅是他在排位赛中犯的那个错误，还有他在赛道上的整体状态，感觉就像一个正在为总冠军而战的车手，但几乎把自己吓得有点过头了，”希夫解释道。
“所以他在车里感觉有点僵硬，因为他不想犯错。而那也不是一个正确的状态。”
她补充说：“他只需要摆脱心里的杂念。这种情况以前也发生过。上赛季他也经常陷入自己的思绪中。他设法控制住了，之后开车就更放得开了。赛季开始时，他焕然一新。”
“我真的希望他不会因为想太多而把自己吓住，因为这事其实很简单。这完全是心理博弈，一旦钻进牛角尖，你就会开始担心各种事情，而这些担心往往会自己应验。所以我希望他能放轻松、放开自己。”
尽管安东内利在巴库度过了艰难的一个周末，他目前在车手总冠军积分榜上仍然以66分的优势领先排名第二的队友拉塞尔。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" amid F1 title pressure, says Naomi Schiff
Naomi Schiff believes championship leader Kimi Antonelli must overcome the psychological pressure of his Formula 1 title fight
Championship leader Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" and must "get out of his head" to avoid crumbling under the pressure of the Formula 1 fight, according to pundit Naomi Schiff.

The Mercedes driver arrived at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix with a commanding 81-point lead. But that advantage was reduced to 66 points after team-mate George Russell successfully converted pole position to a race win, while Antonelli finished fifth after starting from 16th on the grid.

Speaking on the Up To Speed podcast, former W Series driver and Sky Sports F1 pundit Schiff warned that the Italian driver's body language in Baku suggested he was starting to feel the pressure of his maiden championship fight.

"I felt like when I was looking at Kimi on track this weekend and not just the mistake that he made [in qualifying], but just his general demeanour on track, it felt like a driver who's driving for that championship, but has almost spooked himself a little bit too much," Schiff explained.
"So he feels a little bit stiff in the car because he doesn't want to make a mistake. And that's also not the right place to be in."

She added: "He just needs to get out of his head. And we've seen it happen before. Last season he was in his head a lot as well. He managed to get that under control, and then he was driving more freely. He came into the beginning of the season a new man.

"I really hope that he's not going to spook himself out of this because it is so easy. It's such a psychological game that once you get in your head, you start worrying about things. You almost bring those things to yourself. So I hope he can free himself up."
Although Antonelli endured a difficult weekend in Baku, he still holds a 66-point lead in the drivers' championship over his team-mate Russell, who sits in second.

items.originalTitle: George Russell details F1 drivers' Langkawi boys' trip ahead of Bahrain GP in Malaysia
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell has shared details of a boys' trip to Langkawi with six other Formula 1 drivers, which included a local go-karting race, ahead of this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix.
detailZh: 拉塞尔详细讲述了F1车手们的兰卡威之旅
拉塞尔透露了在巴林大奖赛前F1车手们前往兰卡威旅行的细节
梅赛德斯车手拉塞尔分享了与好友们前往兰卡威度假的细节，行程中包括一场当地卡丁车比赛，此行安排在本周末的巴林大奖赛之前。
拉塞尔在Instagram上发布了此次与六位F1车手同行的照片，他们分别是奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里、亚历克斯·阿尔本、奥利弗·比尔曼、卡洛斯·塞恩斯、加布里埃尔·博托莱托和兰多·诺里斯。
照片显示这群人在瀑布前合影、玩卡丁车、下棋，还有诺里斯拍摄他的迈凯伦队友的画面，大概是在为他的Prime纪录片系列拍摄素材。
在吉隆坡双子塔举行的新闻发布会上，拉塞尔接受了包括Motorsport.com在内的媒体采访，他解释说这次行程安排受到了梅赛德斯冠名合作伙伴马石油的影响。
“所以我们和其他六位车手一起去了，我们度过了一段非常美好的时光。那是一个非常非常美丽的地方。那里的人们非常友好，感觉像是身处一个不同的世界。所以我非常享受那次旅行，这是为本周做准备的完美方式。”
拉塞尔的队友安东内利也提前抵达马来西亚，但他利用这段时间游览了吉隆坡，还去了一个水上乐园。
“我玩得非常开心，”目前的积分榜领跑者解释道。“人很少，所以我可以反复去玩滑梯。大约三分钟里我把同一条滑梯玩了五次，所以就是不停地跑上跑下。感觉很好。”
“除此之外，我一直在马来西亚这里，在市区四处转转。总体来说，能看到吉隆坡真的很酷。我没有尝试任何传统美食，因为，嗯，也许等这个周末之后再说吧……”
在拉塞尔于阿塞拜疆大奖赛夺冠之后，安东内利带着66分的积分榜领先优势进入（在马来西亚之后举行的）巴林大奖赛。
detailEn: George Russell details F1 drivers' Langkawi boys' trip ahead of Bahrain GP in Malaysia
George Russell has revealed details of a Formula 1 drivers' trip to Langkawi ahead of the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
Mercedes driver George Russell has shared details of a boys' trip to Langkawi, which included a local go-karting race, ahead of this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
Taking to Instagram, Russell posted photographs of the trip with six other Formula 1 drivers: Oscar Piastri, Alex Albon, Oliver Bearman, Carlos Sainz, Gabriel Bortoleto and Lando Norris.
The photos show the group posing in front of a waterfall, go-karting, and playing chess, as well as Norris filming his McLaren team-mate, presumably for his Prime docuseries.
Speaking to media, including Motorsport.com, at a press conference at the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur, Russell explained the itinerary was influenced by Mercedes title partner Petronas.

"So we went with six other drivers, and we had a really amazing time. It's such a beautiful, beautiful place. The people are so friendly, and it felt like a different world being there. So I really enjoyed that, and it was the perfect way to prepare for this week."
Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli also arrived in Malaysia early, but instead used his time to explore Kuala Lumpur and go to a water park.

"I had a lot of fun," the current championship leader explained. "There were few people, so I could go on the slide repeatedly. I did the same slide five times in like three minutes, so I was just running up and down. It was good.

"And then other than that, I've been here in Malaysia, I've been going around the city. It was really cool to see KL in general. I didn't try any traditional food because, yeah, maybe after the weekend..."
Antonelli heads into the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia with a 66-point lead in the standings after Russell's win at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
keyPointsZh: 同行的车手包括皮亚斯特里、阿尔本、比尔曼、塞恩斯、博托莱托和诺里斯

items.originalTitle: F1 pundit says drivers are "complicit" if they stay silent on fan abuse
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 broadcaster Will Buxton says drivers who fail to publicly condemn toxic online abuse from their supporters are "complicit" in the behaviour. The remarks follow backlash from Alpine driver Franco Colapinto's Argentine fanbase after 2025 F1 champion Lando Norris's heat-of-the-moment comments following the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: F1评论员表示，如果车手对车迷辱骂保持沉默，就是"同谋"
威尔·巴克斯顿认为，车手如果不公开谴责来自其车迷群体的恶劣网络攻击，就是对这种行为得以持续的"同谋"
F1转播评论员威尔·巴克斯顿表示，车手如果不公开谴责其支持者的恶劣网络攻击行为，就是这种行为的"同谋"。
2025年F1冠军兰多·诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛后的情绪化言论，引发了阿尔派车手弗兰科·科拉平托热情的阿根廷车迷群体在网上的大规模反扑。
科拉平托在巴库的安全车重启时锁死轮胎，引发了一场多车相撞事故。他撞上了自己的队友皮埃尔·加斯利，加斯利随后又撞上了诺里斯。由于这次碰撞，三名车手全部退出了比赛。
比赛结束后立即接受媒体采访时，诺里斯声称有些车手“不应该出现在一级方程式里”，并主张应该对科拉平托处以禁赛处罚。这位迈凯伦车手后来为他的言论公开道歉，但那时他已经收到了大量的网络辱骂。
在《Up To Speed》播客的一期节目中，巴克斯顿认为，车手们在制止自己粉丝的辱骂行为方面负有部分责任。
“任何公众人物，尤其是体育明星，如果他们的粉丝群体在社交媒体上对其他粉丝、其他运动员或公众人物发表这类言论，他们都有责任站出来制止。我认为他们绝对有责任指出这种行为的错误，”巴克斯顿说。
当有人指出科拉平托此前曾发布声明反对其粉丝群体的任何辱骂性言论时，巴克斯顿补充道：“但这个星期他没有这么做，而且这种情况如今已成为常态。所以，如果他发过声明，那他发得够强硬吗？而且这不仅仅是弗朗哥·科拉平托一个人的问题。
弗朗哥·科拉平托，阿尔派；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦；皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派。
“同样的事情在佩雷兹和他的粉丝身上多年来反复发生。我记得2021年阿布扎比大奖赛之后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿的粉丝非常恶毒。那个冬天，我收到的内容令人作呕。尼古拉斯·拉蒂菲在那个冬天期间甚至收到了死亡威胁。
“那些粉丝发表这类言论的车手有责任站出来说话，明确表示：‘你们不代表我，我不希望你们发表这些言论。’如果你不这么做，那你就是对这种行为的持续纵容。
“你必须表明立场。如果你真心希望人们相信你想要看到这一切结束，那你就必须表明立场、亮明态度，因为沉默本身就是一种同谋。”
detailEn: F1 pundit says drivers are "complicit" if they stay silent on fan abuse
Will Buxton has argued that drivers who fail to publicly condemn toxic online abuse from their fanbases are "complicit" in allowing it to continue
Formula 1 broadcaster Will Buxton says drivers who fail to publicly condemn toxic online abuse from their supporters are "complicit" in the behaviour.
2025 F1 champion Lando Norris's heat-of-the-moment comments following the Azerbaijan Grand Prix led to a wave of backlash online from Alpine driver Franco Colapinto's passionate Argentine fanbase.

Colapinto locked up and triggered a multi-car crash at the safety car restart in Baku. He collided with his team-mate Pierre Gasly, who in turn crashed into Norris. All three drivers were out of the race as a result of the contact.

While speaking to the media immediately after the race, Norris claimed some drivers "shouldn't be in F1" and argued that Colapinto should be given a race ban. The McLaren driver later released an apology for his comments, but he had already received a large amount of online abuse.
During an episode of the Up To Speed podcast, Buxton argued that drivers are partly responsible for stopping the abuse from their fans.

"It's [incumbent] on any public figure, particularly sports people, if their fan base engages in this kind of rhetoric against other fans, against other sports players or public personalities or whatever within this social media space. I think it is absolutely incumbent on them to call it out," Buxton said.

When it was pointed out that Colapinto has previously released a statement against any abusive comments from his fan base, Buxton added: "But not this week, and this is now a regular occurrence. So, if he's done it, has he done it strongly enough? And this isn't just a Franco Colapinto issue.
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine

"The same thing has happened repeatedly for years with Sergio Perez and his fans. I remember back in 2021 after Abu Dhabi, Lewis Hamilton's fans were vile. Over the winter, I received stuff that was utterly disgusting. Nicholas Latifi was receiving death threats over that winter period.

"It is incumbent on the drivers whose fan bases are making these comments to stand up, say something and say, 'You do not represent me, and I do not want you making these comments,' and if you don't, then you are complicit in it continuing.
"You have to take a stand. If you truly want people to believe that you want to see it end, then you have to take a stand and you have to take a position because being silent is complicity in it."
keyPointsZh: 巴克斯顿的观点针对的是车迷群体的恶劣网络攻击行为
科拉平托效力阿尔派车队，其阿根廷车迷群体在网上发起反扑
keyPointsEn: Buxton's comments target toxic online abuse from fanbases
Colapinto drives for Alpine, whose passionate Argentine fanbase launched the online backlash

items.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
items.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
items.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
items.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.
